mapper.sql: SELECT w.id AS w_id, w.data AS w_data, w.event_result AS w_event_result, w.event_type AS w_event_type, w.insert_instant AS w_insert_instant, w.last_attempt_instant AS w_last_attempt_instant, w.last_update_instant AS w_last_update_instant, w.linked_object_id AS w_linked_object_id, w.sequence AS w_sequence, wa.id as wa_id, wa.data AS wa_data, wa.end_instant AS wa_end_instant, wa.start_instant AS wa_start_instant, wa.webhook_event_logs_id AS wa_webhook_event_logs_id, wa.webhooks_id AS wa_webhooks_id FROM webhook_event_logs AS w LEFT OUTER JOIN webhook_attempt_logs AS wa ON w.id = wa.webhook_event_logs_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webhook_event_logs (id, data, event_result, event_type, insert_instant, last_attempt_instant, last_update_instant, linked_object_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{dataToDatabase}, #{eventResult}, #{eventType}, #{insertInstant}, #{lastAttemptInstant}, #{lastUpdateInstant}, #{linkedObjectId})
